The climate in Cork

Cork is about 9 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 19°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 3°C. Around 1170 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in October (about 135 mm).

Best time to visit Cork

The most pleasant weather in Cork is usually in July and August: average highs are around 19°C, with up to 14 days of rain a month.
